# Review findings ledger: {{PROJECT_NAME}}

_Template. One row per finding from every review round (see the review protocol), kept for the life of the project. Map it as the **Review findings** role in the "Project docs" table in `CLAUDE.md`. Commits and PRs that address a finding cite its ID (e.g. `R2-03`) in the body; a task created from a finding cites it in its Context. Reviewers read this first and never re-report an ID that is already here._

Status: `open` · `fixed` (code or doc changed; say where) · `resolved` (no change needed, or answered) · `accepted` (owner accepted the risk) · `superseded` (by another ID).
